item.title: Show HN: Fake Zoom, hang out with AI coworkers and feel the synergy
item.summary: This is so stupid. I made a fake Zoom call with AI coworkers. I generated the videos of each coworker with my 5070 ti and Minimax H3. Click on people to hear them talk or try saying their name to hear their standup update. If you say "STOP" they should stop talking. Enjoy I guess Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49423295 Points: 3 # Comments: 0
